questions.question: In a division action, the divisor is 32 times the quotient and 12 times the remainder. If the remainder is 56, what will the dividend be?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Divisor = 32 × Quotient

Divisor = 12 × Reminder

**Formula:**

Remainder formula:

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder

**Calculation:**

Remainder = 56

Divisor = 56 × 12 = 672

Quotient = 672/32 = 21

Dividend = 21 × 672 + 56 = 14168

**∴ Dividend is 14168 when remainder is 56.**

questions.question: The average weight of students in a class is 49kg. Five new students are admitted in the class whose weights are 45 kg, 46.8 kg, 47.4 kg, 54.2 kg and 63.6 kg. Now, the average weight of all the students in the class is 50 kg. The number of students in the class in the beginning was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of class = 49kg

New average weight of all students in a class = 50kg

**Formula:**

Average weight of n students = Total weight of n students/n

**Calculation:**

Let original number of students in a class be n.

Original total weight of a class = n × 49 = 49n kg

New total weight of a class = 49n + 45 + 46.8 + 47.4 + 54.2 + 63.6 = 49n + 257

Total new number of students in a class = n + 5

New total weight of a class = 50(n + 5) = 50n + 250

Then,

⇒ 49n + 257 = 50n + 250

⇒ n = 7

**∴ There are 7 students in a class in the beginning.**

questions.question: An article marked at Rs.560 is sold at 20% discount. If there is a profit of 40%, then what is the cost price (in Rs) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price of an article = Rs.560

Discount percentage = 20%

Profit percentage = 40%

**Formula:**

Selling price = Marked price × (100 - discount %)/100

Profit % = (SP - CP)/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Selling price = 560 × (100 - 20)/100 = Rs.448

Then,

⇒ 40 = (448 - CP)/CP × 100

⇒ CP = 320

**∴ Cost price of an article is Rs.320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Selling price = cost price × (100 + profit %)/100

Here,

**∴ Cost price of an article = 448 × 100/(100 + 40) = Rs.320**

questions.question: Apoorv bought 26 kg of apples for Rs.2,340. He sold them at a profit equal to the selling price of 6 kg of apples. The selling price of apples per kg, was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of 26kg apples = Rs.2340

**Formula:**

Profit = Selling price - cost price

**Calculation:**

Cost price of 26 kg apples = Rs.2340

Let selling price of 1 kg apple be Rs.a.

Selling price of 6kg apples = Rs.6a

Profit after selling 26kg apples = Rs.6a

Selling price of 26kg apples = Rs.26a

Then,

⇒ 6a = 26a - 2340

⇒ a = 117

**∴ Selling price of 1 kg apple is Rs.117.**

questions.question: If the radius of a right circular cone is decreased by 20% and its height is increased by 60%, then its volume:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of cone decreased by = 20%

Height of cone increased by = 60%

**Formula:**

Volume of cone = 1/3 × πr²h

where r = radius of cone and h = height of cone

**Calculation:**

Let r and h be the radius and height of cone respectively.

Original volume of cone = 1/3 × πr²h

New radius of cone = r - r × 20/100 = 4r/5

New height of cone = h + h × 60/100 = 8h/5

New volume of cone = 1/3 × π(4r/5)²(8h/5) = 1/3 × πr²h × 128/125

% Increase in volume of cone = (1/3 × πr²h × 128/125 - 1/3 × πr²h)/1/3 × πr²h × 100 = (128/125 - 1) × 100 = 2.4%

**∴ Volume of cone is increased by 2.4% than original volume of cone.**

questions.question: A certain amounts to Rs.6,655 at 10%p.a. in 3 years. The same sum will amount to Rs.x at double the earlier rate in 2dfrac{1}{2} years and if the interest is compounded annually in both cases. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount = Rs.6655

Rate of interest = 10%

Time = 3 years

**Formula:**

Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time period

Compound interest (calculated annually) = P(1 + R/100)N - P

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

**Calculation:**

⇒ 6655 = P(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ P = 5000

Sum invested is Rs.5000.

New rate of interest when sum amounts to Rs.x = 10 × 2 = 20% per annum

Time period when sum amounts to Rs.x = 2.5 years

⇒ x = 5000(1 + 20/100)²(1 + 0.5 × 20/100) = Rs.7920

**∴ Value of x is Rs.7920**

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 12,672 after 4 years and to Rs. 15,744 after 8 years at the same rate percent p.a. at simple interest. The simple interest on the same sum at 10% p.a. for 3dfrac{1}{3} years will be∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 4 years = Rs. 12672

Amount after 8 years = Rs. 15744

**Formula:**

Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time period

Simple interest = PNR/100

Amount = P + PNR/100

**Calculation:**

Let rate of interest and principal be R% and Rs.P respectively.

⇒ 12672 = P + PR × 4/100 ----(1)

⇒ 15744 = P + PR × 8/100 ----(2)

Subtract (1) from (2),

⇒ 3072 = PR × 4/100

⇒ PR = 76800

Add (1) and (2),

⇒ 28416 = 2P + 76800 × 12/100

⇒ P = Rs.9600

**∴ Simple interest at 10% for 10/3 years = 9600 × 10/100 × 10/3 = Rs.3200**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**4 years = Rs. 12672

8 years = Rs. 15744

8 - 4 = 15744 - 12672

4 years = Rs 3072

3072 is interest of 4 years

Amount = Principle + Interest

P = 12672 - 3072 = Rs 9600

According to question 

SI = PRT/100 = 9600 × 10 × (10/3)/100

⇒ Rs 3200

questions.question: The income of A is 125% more than the income of B, and the income of C is 60% less than the total income of A and B. By what percentage is the income of C less than of A (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ A = B + B × 125/100

⇒ C = (A + B) - (A + B) × 60/100

**Calculation:**

⇒ A = 225B/100 = 9B/4

⇒ B = 4A/9

⇒ C = (A + B)40/100 = 2(A + B)/5

⇒ C = 2(A + 4A/9)/5 = 26A/45

Let N be the percentage by which C is less than of A.

⇒ C = A - A × N/100

⇒ C = A × (100 - N)/100

⇒ 100C = 100A - AN

⇒ N = (A - C) × 100/A

⇒ N = (A - 26A/45) × 100/A = 42.22%

**∴ Required percentage = 42.2%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Income of A is 125% more than B i.e 125/100 = +5/4

Income of C is 60% less than B

A : B = 9 : 4 = 90 : 40

Let income of A and B be 90u, 40u respectively

A + B = 130u 

Income of C 60% less means he has (100% - 60%) = 40%

C = 130u × 40/100 = 52u

Income of C is less than A by 90u - 52u = 38u

 ⇒ 38/90 × 100 = 42.22%

questions.question: A and B together can do a certain work in 20 days, B and C together can do it in 30 days, and C and A together can do it in 24 days, B alone will complete dfrac{2}{3} part of the same work is∶
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** LCM(20, 30, 24) = 120 Let work is 120u

 
 

 Days
 Work
 Efficiency
 
 

 (A+B) 20
 
 6
 
 

 (B+C) 30
 120
 4
 
 

 (C+A) 24
 
 5
 
 

Total efficiency 2(A + B + C) = 15u

A + B + C = 7.5u

A = A + B + C - (B+C) = 7.5 - 4 = 3.5u

By same process Efficiency of B = 2.5u, C = 1.5u

B alone can complete = (120 × 2/3)/2.5 = 32 days

**Given:**

⇒ 1/A + 1/B = 1/20

⇒ 1/B + 1/C = 1/30

⇒ 1/A + 1/C = 1/24

**Calculation:**

Solving,

⇒ 1/A - 1/C = 1/20 - 1/30 = 1/60

⇒ 1/A + 1/C = 1/24

Solving,

⇒ 2/A = 1/60 + 1/24 = 7/120

⇒ 1/A = 7/240

Then,

⇒ 1/B = 1/20 - 7/240 = 1/48

B's 1 days work = 1/48

B alone can complete the work in 48 days.

**∴ Time taken by B to complete 2/3rd work = 2/3 × 48 = 32 days **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

** **Total work = LCM of 20, 30 and 24 = 120

In 1 day (A + B) can do 120/20 = 6 units work

In 1 day (B + C) can do 120/30 = 4 units work

In 1 day (A + C) can do 120/24 = 5 units work

In 1 day (A + C + B + C + C + A) = 2(A + B + C) can do 15 unit work

⇒ In 1 day (A + B + C) can do 15/2 = 7.5 units work

⇒ In 1 day B alone can do (A + B + C) - (A + C) = 7.5 - 5 = 2.5 units work

B alone can complete the work in 120/2.5 = 48 days

B alone can do 2/3rd part of the work in 48 × 2/3 = 32 days

**∴ B alone will complete 2/3 part of the same work in 32 days.**

questions.question: A sum of Rs.23,808 is divided between A, B, C and D such that the ratio of the shares of A and B is 8 ∶ 9, that of B and C is 3 ∶ 5, and that of C and D is 1 ∶ 2. What is the shares of B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total amount = Rs.23808

A : B = 8 : 9

B : C = 3 : 5

C : D = 1 : 2

**Calculation:**

Let shares of A and B be Rs.8a and Rs.9a respectively.

Share of C = 5/3 × 9a = Rs.15a

Share of D = 2 × 15a = Rs.30a

⇒ 8a + 9a + 15a + 30a = 23808

⇒ a = 384

**∴ Share of B = 9 × 384 = Rs.3456**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** 

**Given:**

Total amount = Rs.23808

⇒ A : B = 8 : 9

⇒ B : C = 3 : 5

⇒ C : D = 1 : 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 8 : 9

⇒ B : C = 3 : 5 = 3 × 3 : 5 × 3 = 9 : 15

⇒ A : B : C = 8 : 9 : 15

⇒ C : D = 1 : 2 = 15 : 30

⇒ A : B : C : D = 8 : 9 : 15 : 30

**∴ Share of B = 9/62 × 23808 = Rs.3456**

questions.question: The diameter of a circular garden is 140 m. Its area is equal to a rectangular field whose sides are in the ratio 11 ∶ 7. The perimeter (in m) of the rectangular field is (take π = dfrac{22}{7})∶
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of garden = 140m

Ratio of sides of rectangular field = 11 : 7

**Formula:**

Area of circle = πr²

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

**Calculation:**

Radius of circular garden = 140/2 = 70m

Area of circular garden = 22/7 × 70 × 70 = 15400 sq.m

Area of rectangular field = 15400 sq.m

But,

⇒ Length : breadth = 11 : 7

⇒ 15400 = length × breadth

⇒ 15400 = length × 7length/11

⇒ Length = 110√2 cm

Breadth = 7/11 × 110√2 = 70√2 m

**∴ Perimeter of rectangular field = 2(110√2 + 70√2) = 360√2 m**
